model_name: 明新科技大學中正堂、鴻超樓前噴水池
scope: Independent actual-pixel and source-bound exterior appearance review; private only, not release authorization or physical-print certification.

view_observations.observations: Four concentric cascade tiers and taller top drum; warm narrow-strip stone surface, complete charcoal outer ring, pale inner band and narrow lower paving. Open annular basin remains below rim, not a filled high platform. Entire object in frame.
Reverse view confirms continuous rear half of the same full ring, low paving and four-tier center; no invented back wall or partial cut. Entire object in frame.
Four descending tier elevations visible; top riser taller than the three lower risers. Rim and narrow low ground band remain distinct; not four equal-height steps. Entire object in frame.

Whole circular rim, annular negative space and concentric center preserved. Gray horizontal basin closure and plain warm top cap are disclosed display surfaces, not verified submerged construction. No artificial water/nozzle sculpture. Entire object in frame.
Second elevated angle shows four tiers, recessed annulus, continuous rim and paving; surface strip colors approximate the warm stone reference without image textures. Entire object in frame.

source_comparison.principal_topology: Matches the source-confirmed permanent above-water object: four contracting concentric warm-stone cascade tiers, top drum relatively taller, full dark outer basin/coping, pale inner transition, narrow lower outer paving.
source_comparison.dimensions_and_colors: Model dimensions, center-to-ring ratio, heights, coping width and stone strip counts are photographic approximations, not measured engineering dimensions or exact color samples.
source_comparison.version: Official-photo capture dates unknown; video author reports 2026-04-22 visit and 2026-04-24 publication. No claim that the reviewer watched the full video or that this is 2026-10-22 current condition.

manufacturing_boundary.read_builder_evidence: Raw topology report: one connected closed shell, zero listed topology errors. Layer report: 88 layers with every positive component surviving -0.4 mm erosion. Exchange report: lib3mf strict zero warnings. Scene/isolated rebuild reports read; not independently rerun by this appearance reviewer.

required_preserved_disclosures: Dynamic water and all unknown nozzles/pipes/mechanisms are omitted; no visible water jet is claimed as permanent sculpture or an exact nozzle count.
Horizontal submerged basin bottom and highest central flat cap are display closures, not surveyed real bottom depth, slope, top plumbing or foundations.
Preserve full annular recess; do not replace the pool region with a raised solid platform.
Stone strip rhythm and colors are simplified face materials, not exact masonry counts or separable mechanical inlays.
All dimensions and proportions are estimated; surrounding campus, people, vegetation, lamps and video overlays excluded.
Source READY and this exterior PASS do not imply functional fountain, tested print, unsupported print or engineering accuracy.
